question: What form does the six-syllabled mantra take when it is without the tāra syllable?
premises: The mantra is addressed to the Goddess of gods

inference: This mantra is to be understood as a six-syllabled form without the tāra syllable
plain_english: O Goddess of gods, this mantra would be six-syllabled without the tāra.
